boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Cal State East Bay programs that mark the academic year, welcome Pioneers, and recognize campus participation.

cards.title: Weeks of Welcome
cards.subtitle: Semester-opening campus kickoff
cards.notes: Use the event listings during the first weeks of a semester to choose a welcome program that fits your schedule and transition needs.
cards.short_summary: The official opening series for new and returning students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay identifies Weeks of Welcome as its official kickoff of events and programs during the first weeks of each semester.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Check the current Weeks of Welcome event listings for dates, locations, and access details.

cards.title: Ask Me Tabling
cards.subtitle: Start-of-semester student-leader help tables
cards.notes: Stop at a staffed table when finding classes or campus services; bring a specific question and use the conversation to get oriented.
cards.short_summary: Student leaders field practical campus questions at key locations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says Ask Me Tabling lets students ask student leaders for directions and campus questions at key campus spots.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The university lists Ask Me Tabling for August 18–25, excluding Fridays; verify current semester details before visiting.

cards.title: Pioneer Palooza
cards.subtitle: Annual club and organization expo
cards.notes: Walk the expo with a short list of interests, then ask participating organizations how to attend a first meeting or volunteer shift.
cards.short_summary: A named annual introduction to recognized student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay describes Pioneer Palooza, formerly East Bay Round, as its annual club and organization expo.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Listed at the University Union/Meiklejohn Walkway during the first two weeks of the semester; confirm current dates.

cards.title: al Fresco
cards.subtitle: Annual fall welcome festival
cards.notes: Arrive early at the Music Building Lawn, browse resource tables, and stay for the scheduled performances if they match your plans.
cards.short_summary: A fall welcome festival pairing campus resources with performances.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay calls al Fresco its annual fall welcome festival and lists campus and community resource tables, performances, and a DJ.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The page lists the Music Building Lawn and an August date; food is described as available until gone. Verify current details.

cards.title: FalCon: Fall Leadership Conference
cards.subtitle: Fall student leadership gathering
cards.notes: Register or review the program when announced, then select workshops that build a practical skill you can use in a club or class.
cards.short_summary: A named fall conference for emerging student leaders.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says FalCon offers workshops and collaborative activities for emerging leaders to build skills and connections.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The signature-events page lists a South University Union MPR location; confirm the current program and participation requirements.

cards.title: Pioneer Leadership Certificate
cards.subtitle: Eight-module student leadership program
cards.notes: Complete the online modules across the semester and save your reflections so you can apply the certificate work to future leadership roles.
cards.short_summary: A semester-long Pioneer-branded leadership recognition practice.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay describes the Pioneer Leadership Certificate as an online eight-module program, with certificates awarded at semester end.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Available to students through the university’s leadership programming; check the current page for enrollment instructions.

cards.title: National Transfer Student Week
cards.subtitle: Third week of October
cards.notes: Look for the week’s campus programming and use it to connect with transfer-oriented resources, advocates, and fellow transfer students.
cards.short_summary: An annual October recognition of transfer students and advocates.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay states that National Transfer Student Week occurs in the third week of October each year and celebrates transfer students and advocates.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Check the signature-events calendar in October for current activities and locations.

cards.title: Make a Difference Day
cards.subtitle: Annual October service day
cards.notes: Choose a listed service project, follow organizer instructions, and plan transportation and attire based on the assigned community activity.
cards.short_summary: A yearly service-oriented campus participation day.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says Make a Difference Day joins organizations in service each year and identifies the fourth Saturday in October.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The university lists the fourth Saturday in October; review the current project information before participating.

cards.title: Leadership Banquet and SOLAR Awards
cards.subtitle: Recognition for campus student leadership
cards.notes: If your organization has completed a strong project, review award criteria early and keep a record of its service and event work.
cards.short_summary: A campus recognition gathering tied to SOLAR awards.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says its Leadership Banquet recognizes student leaders across campus through SOLAR awards for leaders, organizations, advisors, and departments.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Check current nomination, attendance, and location information with Student Leadership and Involvement.

cards.title: Cultural Graduation Celebrations
cards.subtitle: Graduation ceremonies alongside commencement
cards.notes: Review the current celebration options, registration rules, and any fees early; participating graduates may attend more than one ceremony.
cards.short_summary: Student, faculty, and staff partnerships mark graduating students’ identities and journeys.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says Cultural Graduation Celebrations are held alongside official commencement and are facilitated through partnerships with students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Cultural + Academic Graduation Celebrations | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Participation is voluntary and open to graduating students; registration and fees vary by celebration, so consult the current commencement page.
